Effective line: Find the hideout through the manhole near the gate. Help the Wrinkles, one quest per Path; seal rifts and reach {villain}'s Castle at the north end. Each freed Path mends a broken city service.
Suggested line: Find the Wrinkles' hideout: knock at the manhole near the gate. Help them with one quest for each Path, seal the rifts, and reach {villain}'s Castle at the north end. Each Path you free mends a broken city service.

Effective line: Ow! The Capital has hurt you again. (-HP)
Suggested line: The Capital catches you hard, the way it catches everyone. (-HP)

Effective line: 'Dragged you in by the collar. Correction fee is yours. Drink. Then we can discuss your habit of arriving unconscious.'
Suggested line: 'I dragged you in by the collar, and the correction fee comes out of your purse. Drink. Then we can talk about this habit you have of arriving unconscious.'

Effective line: 'Falling in the approved queue area: minor offence. Fine payable. Stand up, citizen. I cannot measure you along the ground.'
Suggested line: 'Falling down in the approved queue area is a minor offence, and the fine is payable now. Up you get, citizen. I cannot measure you while you are lying along the ground.'

Effective line: You are through the walls. Somewhere a loudspeaker clears its throat. You are now, officially, a Visitor in {capital}, the Capital of {kingdom}.
Suggested line: You're through the walls. Somewhere above you a loudspeaker clears its throat, and you are now, officially, a Visitor in {capital}, the Capital of {kingdom}.

Effective line: You crawl out through the old tunnel and push the rubble aside. The Outskirts again, and a long way from anybody's approved queue.
Suggested line: You crawl out through the old tunnel and shove the rubble aside, and you're back in the Outskirts, a long way from anybody's approved queue.

Effective line: You push past rubble and a toppled statue. You find stairs and read an old plaque: 'THE OLD JOINT WORKS. BUILT BY ALL FOUR PATHS, TOGETHER.'
Suggested line: Past the rubble and a toppled statue, a flight of stairs leads down to an old plaque: 'THE OLD JOINT WORKS. BUILT BY ALL FOUR PATHS, TOGETHER.'

Effective line: The tunnel runs under the wall, under the gate and under every one of {villain}'s checkpoints. You walk under them all. It is the best moment you have had all day.
Suggested line: The tunnel runs under the wall, under the gate and under every one of {villain}'s checkpoints, and you walk beneath them all without being measured once. It's the best moment you've had all day.

Effective line: A manhole by the wall, with a scratch on its lid like a tiny wrinkle. You knock three times, for no reason you can name.
Suggested line: There's a manhole by the wall with a scratch on its lid, like a tiny wrinkle. You knock three times, for no reason you can name.

Effective line: A pause. Then the lid lifts and a hand beckons. A voice mutters, 'Wrinkle?' You decide that, yes, you are.
Suggested line: After a pause the lid lifts and a hand beckons you down. 'Wrinkle?' a voice mutters, and you decide that, yes, you probably are.

Effective line: Already improved. He has a moustache now. He looks, for the first time, like a person.
Suggested line: Someone has already improved this one. With the moustache he looks, for the first time, like a person.

Effective line: You post a complaint. 'Noted,' says the box, gently. You wait. That appears to have been the whole service.
Suggested line: You post a complaint. 'Noted,' says the box, gently, and after a long wait you understand that this was the whole service.

Effective line: You post a complaint. A klaxon sounds. A Perfection Inspector appears from nowhere, measures your frown, writes you up and walks off.
Suggested line: You post a complaint, and a klaxon sounds. A Perfection Inspector appears from nowhere, measures your frown, writes you up and walks off.

Effective line: The box rattles. It is full. It has had enough of your feedback for one visit.
Suggested line: The box rattles, full to the slot. It has had quite enough of your feedback for one visit.

Effective line: This one is too big. It runs all the way up into the castle. It will have to close when he does.
Suggested line: This one is too big to seal. It runs all the way up into the castle, and it will only close when he does.

Effective line: A banished compost heap, hiding in a cellar where it was not allowed to be. It is warm. It is alive.
Suggested line: A banished compost heap is hiding in a cellar where it was never allowed to be, still warm and still very much alive.

Effective line: An old glass jar with one seed in it. The seed is glowing very faintly green. Nobody has planted anything in the Capital for ten years. It has not given up.
Suggested line: An old glass jar holds a single seed, glowing very faintly green. Nobody has planted anything in the Capital for ten years, and the seed hasn't given up.

Effective line: The second wheel has been turning since some of its runners were too small to reach the pedals. A foreman's whistle hangs from a hook. You pocket it.
Suggested line: The second wheel has been turning since some of its runners were too small to reach the pedals. A foreman's whistle hangs on a hook nearby, and you pocket it.

Effective line: The third wheel's crew are children in school caps. 'It is a school activity,' says a banner. Nobody has rung the bell.
Suggested line: The third wheel's crew are children in school caps. 'It is a school activity,' says a banner, but nobody has rung the bell in years.

Effective line: You pull the lever, break the wheel's rhythm and get them off. They are very small and very proud and they will not stop saying 'Rollo sent you?'.
Suggested line: You pull the lever and lift them down one by one. They're very small and very proud, and they keep asking, 'Did Rollo send you?'

Effective line: This crew is free. They are lying on the ground, looking at the sky. It is the best they have felt in ten years.
Suggested line: This crew is free. They're lying on their backs looking up at the sky, and it's the best they've felt in ten years.

Effective line: The Pell plot is tended and quiet. Fresh flowers. The family comes every morning now.
Suggested line: The Pell plot is tended and quiet, with fresh flowers on it. The family comes every morning now.

Effective line: The iron gate is sealed with a notice: 'NO BURIAL WITHOUT A STAMPED PERMIT (FORM 27-B/6, FINAL APPROVAL).' You have no stamp. Widow Pell said something about a stamp, hidden somewhere in Grave Row.
Suggested line: The iron gate is sealed with a notice: 'NO BURIAL WITHOUT A STAMPED PERMIT (FORM 27-B/6, FINAL APPROVAL).' Widow Pell said a stamp was hidden in Grave Row, north of the permit office.

Effective line: 'Form 27-C requires Form 27-B.' 'Form 27-B requires Form 27-C.' 'It is a loop,' you say.
Suggested line: 'Form 27-C requires Form 27-B,' she says, 'and Form 27-B requires Form 27-C.' You point out, gently, that this is a loop.

Effective line: Every citizen shall run the wheels for six hours a day. The wheels never stop. The lights never go out. Your legs are not your own.
Suggested line: Every citizen shall run the wheels for six hours a day, so that the wheels never stop and the lights never go out. Your legs are not your own.

Effective line: Same as yesterday. Same as tomorrow. You may stop consulting the menu.
Suggested line: The same as yesterday and the same as tomorrow. You may stop consulting the menu.

Effective line: To the Crease. There is a smell of cooking down there. Real cooking. Nobody mentions it.
Suggested line: To the Crease. There's a smell of real cooking coming up this shaft, and nobody ever mentions it.

Effective line: Closed. Forgotten. Not on any map. (Try the south-west corner.)
Suggested line: Closed and forgotten, and on nobody's map. (Try the south-west corner.)

Effective line: Founded by people {villain} could not iron out. No dues. No forms. No smiling.
Suggested line: Founded by the people {villain} could not iron out. No dues, no forms, and nobody here has to smile.

Effective line: Another one through the shafts. Sit. I am Wren. I was Royal Archivist, once. Now I keep the records this city is not supposed to have.
Suggested line: Another one through the shafts. Sit down. I'm Wren; I was the Royal Archivist once, and now I keep the records this city isn't supposed to have.

Effective line: Maren sent word from {town} that someone might come. This is the Crease. We are the Wrinkles: the people {villain} could not iron out. We have tea and grudges. The tea is better.
Suggested line: Maren sent word from {town} that someone might come. This is the Crease, and we're the Wrinkles, the people {villain} couldn't iron out. We have tea and grudges. The tea's better.

Effective line: He is in the castle at the north end, and he truly believes he is helping. That is the hard part. Talk to the streets. Each of them holds a piece of him.
Suggested line: He's in the castle at the north end, and he truly believes he's helping, which is the hard part. Talk to the people in the streets. Each of them carries a piece of what he did, and I want it all in the record.

Effective line: The records say he began well. His first decree put a hot lunch in front of every schoolchild. Remember that. It excuses nothing.
Suggested line: The records say he began well. His first decree put a hot lunch in front of every schoolchild, and I want you to remember that. It excuses nothing, but remember it.

Effective line: You brought me something from the streets. It goes in the true record, in ink, where he cannot correct it.
Suggested line: You brought me something from the streets. It goes in the true record, in ink, where he can't correct it.

Effective line: Two pieces of him now. A man who needs to be right. A man who cannot bear to be disagreed with. I can almost see his shape.
Suggested line: That's two pieces of him now: a man who needs to be right, and a man who can't bear to be disagreed with. I can almost see his shape.

Effective line: Three. He is afraid, you know. Not of you.
Suggested line: That's three. He's afraid, you know, and not of you.

Effective line: Of everything that will not obey. A small, sad fear, for a man with so much gold.
Suggested line: He's afraid of everything that won't obey him. It's a small, sad fear for a man with so much gold.

Effective line: All four. I have the whole of him now. He is not a monster.
Suggested line: That's all four, and I have the whole of him now. He is not a monster.

Effective line: He is a man who made a list of everything he could not control, and made it illegal.
Suggested line: He's a man who made a list of everything he couldn't control, and then made it illegal.

Effective line: Hesper Dray. Nurse. Sit. Drink.
Suggested line: Hesper Dray. I'm the nurse down here, so do as I say: sit, and drink.

Effective line: Tea. Strong, bitter, unapproved. Drink while it is still three things the Ministry dislikes.
Suggested line: It's tea, strong and bitter and unapproved. Drink it while it's still three things the Ministry dislikes.

Effective line: The rifts? His hold is failing. Everything he forced together keeps coming apart, and he keeps stitching.
Suggested line: The rifts? That's his hold failing. Everything he forced together keeps coming apart at the seams, and he keeps stitching.
